title: Split by position, not by value
hook: A position can be found without a permanent search key.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Split and merge a sequence treap using subtree counts rather than key comparisons.

misconception: A treap can only represent data sorted by explicit keys.
objective: Split and merge a sequence treap using subtree counts rather than key comparisons.

claims.text: Subtree sizes turn positions into split boundaries without assigning permanent search keys to the letters. Splitting out a contiguous piece and merging the remaining pieces moves a whole block without rewriting each position.
